name: EctoPad
notes: Manifest owned by the game repository: Metaforce and its components at EctoPad's tested pins plus EctoPad's changes (scripts/bootstrap-workspace.sh), built with no game data; players import their disc image in the app.

inputs.description: Your own Metroid Prime (USA, Rev 2, GM8E01) disc image. You import it in EctoPad after installing; the build does not read it.

tools.name: rustup
tools.note: Install Rust with rustup and add the iPhone target; see PadMint's before-build line for this game.

tools.name: xcodebuild
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

tools.name: xcrun
tools.label: Xcode iPhoneOS SDK
tools.note: Install Xcode 26 or newer with its iOS platform, then select it in Xcode Settings > Locations > Command Line Tools; Command Line Tools alone are not enough.

publication.reason: EctoPad publishes source; each player builds and signs their own copy. The Metroid Prime disc image is imported in the app.

steps: Open {file} and move EctoPad.app to your Applications folder.
Open EctoPad and choose Select Game to pick your own Metroid Prime (USA, Rev 2) disc image; next time, Load Previous Game opens it again.
Updating? Replace the old EctoPad.app with the new one. Your saves and disc choice are kept.
Abre {file} y mueve EctoPad.app a tu carpeta Aplicaciones.
Abre EctoPad y elige Select Game para escoger tu propia imagen de disco de Metroid Prime (EE. UU., Rev 2); la próxima vez, Load Previous Game la vuelve a abrir.
¿Actualizando? Reemplaza el EctoPad.app anterior por el nuevo. Tus partidas y el disco elegido se conservan.
Abra {file} e mova o EctoPad.app para a sua pasta Aplicativos.
Abra o EctoPad e escolha Select Game para selecionar a sua própria imagem de disco de Metroid Prime (EUA, Rev 2); da próxima vez, Load Previous Game a abre de novo.
Atualizando? Substitua o EctoPad.app antigo pelo novo. Seus saves e o disco escolhido são mantidos.
